note: Multi-label case alternatives as written in the source, which reach the parser differently from the merged alternative merged_case_labels builds out of two identical bodies - the two paths meet only in the backend. Three labels on one alternative, two on the next, and a default beneath them; the stimulus visits every label individually, so a dropped one is a single row falling through to the default rather than a whole alternative disappearing. Behavioral because that fall-through is a legal case statement with a different answer.
